summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as Jest presets but its preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB obfuscated file `math_init.js` (a Bun-compiled CJS blob starting with `// @bun @bun-cjs` followed by a rotation function and a shuffled constant array). setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (`_0x...`) and per-scope string dictionaries hiding the download/extract/execute chain. The alternate Bun runtime is used specifically to execute an opaque payload that Node-based tooling will not evaluate. A Jest presets package has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or a `math_init` module, and the obfuscation of both the loader and the payload defeats review. This grants the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
